additional_info.subject: RE: 0411586 - ID0411586-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S6 313706372004] Converter CanComm loss CRM:00641001196
additional_info.body:
Dear Daniel,
I hope this message finds you well.
Regarding the reported issue, it has been observed that a error CanCommLoss has been captured on SCB with
Missing Converters in DC1
In such cases, the converter can communication wiring might be loose. We recommend verifying the all the can connections with the help of the troubleshooting document.
If all the wiring is properly secured, it is likely that converter may be faulty or damaged. (
PowerConverter[5])
The converter reporting the issue to the SCB is likely the one that needs replacement or further investigation.
Kindly check the connection for troubleshoot the issue.
Kindly refer the attached troubleshooting document so trace out the issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - Dynamics 365
and please ensure to carry a spare converter and can communication in case a replacement is required.
Conveter spare-: 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
Can communication cable-: 8EM5903-0AA02-0AA2 corelate with existing
For future reference, your ticket number is 0411586, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
